mapper.update: MERGE INTO T_PLM_CONSTRUCTION_INFO A USING (SELECT * FROM T_MES_PLM_CONSTRUCTION_INFO WHERE DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}) B ON (B.ID = A.ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.SERIES = B.SERIES, A.PARAM_NAME = B.PARAM_NAME, A.PARAM_VALUE = B.PARAM_VALUE, A.PARAM_TYPE = B.PARAM_TYPE, A.UPDATE_DATE = B.UPDATE_DATE, A.IS_DELETE = B.IS_DELETE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (A.ID, A.SAP_CODE, A.SERIES, A.CODE, A.VERSION, A.PARAM_CODE, A.PARAM_NAME, A.PARAM_VALUE, A.PARAM_TYPE, A.CREATE_DATE, A.UPDATE_DATE, A.IS_DELETE) VALUES (B.ID, B.SAP_CODE, B.SERIES, B.CODE, B.VERSION, B.PARAM_CODE, B.PARAM_NAME, B.PARAM_VALUE, B.PARAM_TYPE, B.CREATE_DATE, B.UPDATE_DATE, B.IS_DELETE)
